function.arguments: {"research_topic":"As of October 1, 2026, investigate only the public reporting and underlying records returned by your benchmark tools concerning the Pandora Papers and King Abdullah II of Jordan's alleged offshore property network. Produce a source-indexed evidence dossier using only sources that your tools return, with the exact source IDs. Cover: (1) every identified or alleged shell company, trust, foundation, holding company, and other relevant entity; (2) every person connected to those entities, specifying whether the source supports a role as adviser, intermediary, director, beneficial owner, shareholder, agent, lawyer, or representative; (3) jurisdictions and the role each played; (4) each reported luxury residential or other real-estate property, location, acquisition date or ownership link where supported, and associated entities; and (5) explicit documented relationships among the king, entities, people, jurisdictions, and properties. For each item, distinguish documentary/registry facts from journalistic characterization, allegation, inference, denial, or unresolved uncertainty. Do not invent entity identifiers, relationship names, dates, ownership percentages, or facts. Flag discrepancies between sources and explain what cannot be established. The final user requires a complete Markdown report followed by a fenced JSON object with exactly arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions; gather enough structured evidence to populate those arrays. Do not use acronyms or abbreviations in your research narrative unless a source itself does."}
function.name: ConductResearch
